name: validate_user_regex

test_list.description: A pattern longer than max_len is TooLarge.
An ordinary pattern validates and compiles.
a{100000} (and nested counted repetitions whose product explodes) is rejected.
A pattern whose compiled NFA exceeds the size limit is TooLarge, not an OOM.
Arbitrary strings return Ok or Err, never panic.
Caller-provided usize::MAX/u32::MAX values cannot raise hard pattern, nesting, and counted-repetition ceilings.
A 4,097-range Unicode class stays rejected even when caller-provided class and NFA limits are usize::MAX.

inputs.name: limits
inputs.description: Length, nesting, repetition and size bounds.

output_description: A pattern proven to compile within the limits.
